title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30396: expose sales document lookup
summary: The lookup procedure in the Copy Sales Document report is now public, allowing report extensions to reuse the standard sales document selection logic without duplication.
key_points: LookupSalesDoc procedure made public in Copy Sales Document report
Extensions can now invoke standard sales document lookup directly
Preserves all existing lookup behavior and filters
Change applied to both W1 and APAC layers
Eliminates need for extensions to duplicate lookup logic
quote: Extensions with custom source document types need to reuse the standard sales document lookup instead of duplicating its filters and selection behavior.
